kpi.name_fr: Nombre de lancements Electron realises dans l annee

2020.titre: Rocket Lab, rapport annuel 10-K exercice 2021, section Launch Vehicle Build-Rate and Launch Cadence
2020.extrait: We launched seven vehicles in 2020 and launched six vehicles in 2021.

2021.titre: Rocket Lab, rapport annuel 10-K exercice 2021, section Launch Vehicle Build-Rate and Launch Cadence
2021.extrait: We launched seven vehicles in 2020 and launched six vehicles in 2021.

2022.titre: Rocket Lab, rapport annuel 10-K exercice 2022, section Launch Vehicle Build-Rate and Launch Cadence
2022.extrait: We launched seven vehicles in 2020, six vehicles in 2021 and nine vehicles in 2022.

2023.titre: Rocket Lab, rapport annuel 10-K exercice 2023, section Launch Vehicle Build-Rate and Launch Cadence
2023.extrait: We launched six vehicles in 2021, nine vehicles in 2022 and ten vehicles in 2023.

2024.titre: Rocket Lab, rapport annuel 10-K exercice 2024, section Launch Vehicle Build-Rate and Launch Cadence
2024.extrait: We launched nine Electron vehicles in 2022, ten Electron vehicles in 2023 and 16 Electron vehicles in 2024.

2025.titre: Rocket Lab, rapport annuel 10-K exercice 2025, section Launch Vehicle Build-Rate and Launch Cadence
2025.extrait: We launched ten Electron vehicles in 2023, 16 Electron vehicles in 2024 and 21 Electron vehicles in 2025.

note: Serie courte de 6 exercices civils clos au 31 decembre : la societe n est cotee que depuis aout 2021 et ne publie de decompte annuel qu a partir de son premier rapport annuel, qui remonte a 2020. Le premier vol d Electron date de mai 2017. Le decompte inclut les vols orbitaux et les vols suborbitaux HASTE, reussis ou non. Controle : 2022 (neuf lancements) confirme par le rapport de l exercice 2024 et 2023 (dix lancements) confirme par le rapport de l exercice 2025.
